lore: Wraeclast remembers every sin you dare to repeat.
Exile, the shore was mercy. This is not.
The gods have stopped listening. Fate has not.
Maps fade, monuments crumble, legends reroll.
Some destinies are forged in blood; others in chance.
Kaom had a plan. You have a roll.
Karui drums, Eternal banners, one long scream.
Innocence burned, Sin smiled, and the world kept turning.
The Ancients whisper; the Randomancer answers.
Every shard of corruption hides an opportunity.
Not all experiments survive their creators.
You brought flasks and hope. Leave with stories.
The land is cruel. Your build can be crueler.
When the dead won’t stay down, neither should your ideas.
meta: Meta got you down? Wraeclast has other plans.
Good builds farm maps. Great builds generate stories.
Balance passes are temporary. terrible ideas are eternal.
If the forums hate it, you’re probably onto something.
The best loot is the friends confused along the way.
May your flasks be full and your expectations low.
When in doubt, blame desync. When inspired, blame this roll.
Warning: contents may include joy, regret, or both.

subtitles: Conjure the impossible. Defy the meta.
Fate is just another loot table.
Reckless by design, ruthless by accident.
Because ‘viable’ is such a boring word.
The meta is a suggestion, not a sentence.
Leave the comfort zone in Oriath.
For when respeccing once just isn’t enough.
fallback_flavor: Every exile is a bad idea refined.
Wraeclast shapes steel and souls the same way.
Some paths are chosen. This one was rolled.
The gods watch. The map device does not care.
Between hope and horror lies one more build.

base: Karui war-songs, Eternal shields, one steady heartbeat.
Steel sings loudest when swung with purpose.
Hearts of iron, hands of scarred flesh.
War is their language; victory is their accent.
Let armour crack before conviction does.
named_lore: Kaom carved his legend in flesh; you’ll etch yours across Wraeclast.
Rakiata would approve of this axe, if not of your sanity.
Valako hears every warcry; Tukohama counts every corpse.
Ngamahu feeds the forge, and you feed the battlefield.
Karui blood, Tasalio’s tide, and a very bad day for armour.
Tukohama builds fortresses; you turn them into anecdotes.
lore_mode: Ngamakanui raised you; Wraeclast sharpened you.
Kaom broke the Eternal Empire; you break whatever’s left.
Karui chiefs pray to Hinekora. Warriors like you give her work.
Voll’s legions marched in order; your enemies leave in pieces.
Ngamahu feeds the forge; you feed the funeral pyres.
Tukohama builds fortresses, Tasalio raises waves, and you bring the storm in between.
Maraketh riders charge. Karui warriors like you make them reconsider.

base: Arrows write histories in bone and bark.
Tracks in the dust, death in the wind.
The first warning is the last feather.
The wild draws lines; she crosses all of them.
Predators hunt. Rangers finish.
named_lore: Marceus Lioneye trained soldiers; Hyrri trained survivors.
Hyrri’s ghost nods whenever the arrow finds a throat.
Lioneye would call this overkill. He lacked imagination.
From Sarn’s walls to Wraeclast’s wilds, the bow still decides who speaks.
Lunaris watches the hunt; Solaris judges the shot.
Karui trackers listen for Hinekora; you listen for the twang of the last bowstring.
lore_mode: Marceus Lioneye held Sarn’s walls; you hold the killing fields.
Hyrri’s last arrow never fell to the ground. Yours rarely need a second.
Maraketh wind-riders fear no charge—only the arrow they never saw.
Lioneye trained soldiers; Hyrri trained ghosts. You learn from both.
From Sarn’s battlements to Karui shores, the bow has always decided who walks away.
Rhoas trample the careless—your arrows teach them manners.
Out here, every feathered shaft is a signed letter from Lioneye’s old playbook.

base: Hinekora counts every footprint and every corpse.
The forest keeps her secrets and her dead.
She names her spears and forgets her fears.
Moonlit branches, daylight scars.
The pack howls; she answers alone.
named_lore: Hinekora counts each kill; you just stack them.
Rakiata taught axes to dance; you taught spears to stalk.
Karui hunters follow Tasalio’s tides; you follow the blood.
When Hinekora dreams of prey, she dreams of you.
Tukohama builds fortresses; you draw their weak points in the dirt.
Kaom hunted tribes; you hunt whatever’s foolish enough to move.
lore_mode: Hinekora counts your kills in a language the living never hear.
Karui hunters stalk with Rakiata’s patience and Ngamahu’s temper. You favour both.
Azmeri shamans listen to the woods breathe; you listen for the last gasp.
On Ngamakanui, they chase boars. Here, you chase whatever thinks it’s the predator.
Tukohama builds palisades; you map the gaps before the first spear flies.
When Karui storytellers boast of hunts, they quietly hope you’re not in the audience.
Azmeri myths speak of beasts that cannot be tracked. Your footprints say otherwise.

base: Vaal whispers, Oriathan scriptures, her own conclusions.
Knowledge is a kindness she cannot afford.
Her books are bound in promises and regrets.
Every syllable pulls on something beneath reality.
The dead listen when she speaks firmly enough.
named_lore: Atziri sought perfection; you seek better results.
Doryani twisted Vaal flesh; you twist whatever’s left.
Malachai took notes; you take liberties.
The Vaal carved history into stone; you carve it into souls.
When Atziri whispers from the past, you whisper back with new experiments.
Doryani had theories. You have practical demonstrations.
lore_mode: Atziri ruled an empire; you rule whatever’s left of her nightmares.
Doryani carved knowledge into Vaal flesh—your notes are less merciful.
Malachai rewrote Oriath in blood; you prefer smaller, more frequent edits.
Azmeri seers stare into the dark. You persuade it to stare back.
Vaal architects raised obsidian monuments; you raise less stable things.
Atziri sought perfection; you seek repeatable, weaponised failure.
Doryani chased ultimate power. You chase what happens after that.

base: Storms obey a confident gesture.
She charts constellations in seared nerve endings.
Between heartbeat and thunderclap, she makes a choice.
Frost, flame, and storm—three tempers, one will.
The sky itself is just more range.
named_lore: Solaris burns, Lunaris blinds; you orchestrate the eclipse.
Innocence fell, Sin smiled, and your crits filled the silence.
Oriath forged zealots; Wraeclast forged you.
Sin offers power, Solaris offers light, and you accept everything.
When Lunaris dances across the sky, you keep the tempo.
Innocence preached restraint; your spellbook missed that sermon.
lore_mode: Innocence burned Oriath; you learned to strike a little cleaner.
Sin whispers in every crit; Solaris and Lunaris argue over the lighting.
Templar courts preached restraint—your spellbook skipped that chapter.
Oriath forged zealots for Dominus; Wraeclast forged you for everything else.
Solaris blinds, Lunaris deceives, and you choreograph the finale.
Kitava devoured Oriath; your storms sort through what he spat back out.
Innocence demanded purity. Your mana pool didn’t get the message.

base: Chayula dreams; he walks the edges.
Breath in, blades out.
His scars are prayers that were answered.
Stillness breaks bones as cleanly as motion.
Patience is the sharpest weapon he carries.
named_lore: Chayula’s whispers are loudest when you are silent.
Esh, Tul, Xoph, Uul-Netol—four nightmares, one steady breath.
Oriath wrote sermons; you wrote scars.
When Chayula bends reality, you bend back.
Uul-Netol cracks the earth; you crack the cultist.
Tul chills the spirit; you warm it with broken bones.
lore_mode: Azmeri ascetics starve the body; you starve your doubts.
Chayula folds reality in on itself. You unfold it with your fists.
Esh crackles in every doubt, Tul chills every breath; you exhale discipline.
Xoph’s embers tempt rage; you box it, label it, and break jaws with it.
Uul-Netol splits stone like kindling. You do the same to ideology.
Templar cloisters wrote sermons; Azmeri mountains wrote you.
Breach lords offer power without peace. You bring peace without survivors.

base: Oriath taught him debt; Wraeclast taught him terms.
Contracts end. Consequences do not.
Gold glitters; steel convinces.
They sell violence, not loyalty.
The only flag they salute is survival.
named_lore: Oriath pays in coin; Wraeclast pays in scars.
Theopolis signs the contracts; you stain them red.
Innocence preached virtue; your employer preached hazard pay.
Kitava ate Oriath; you pick through what’s left.
From Sarn’s gutters to Wraeclast’s ruins, the job stays the same.
Victario staged revolutions; you stage cleanups.
lore_mode: Victario stirred rebellions; you tidy up what’s left of them.
Theopolis writes laws, Oriath enforces them, and you invoice both.
Dominus had his Blackguards; you’re a one-person contract.
Kitava ate Oriath—someone still has to get paid.
From Sarn’s gutters to Theopolis’ marble halls, bloodstains look the same.
Templar lords argue doctrine while you negotiate hazard pay.
Victario rallied the people. You remind them what a missed payment costs.

Titan: Titan: Valako marks the blow, Tasalio holds the ground, and you turn both into aftershocks.
Titan: Voll built legions to stand firm; you are a one-person landslide.
Titan: When the earth remembers a battle, it remembers your slams first.
Warbringer: Warbringer: Kaom’s warcries shook empires; yours shake what’s left of them.
Warbringer: Valako counts the fallen, Tukohama counts the scars, and you keep their attention.
Warbringer: Karui drums announce armies; your roar announces conclusions.
Smith of Kitava: Smith of Kitava: You hammer steel the way Kitava chews cities—slow, loud, and thorough.
Smith of Kitava: Oriath fed Kitava; you feed the forge with everything that crawls out.
Smith of Kitava: Every spark from your anvil is a prayer that Kitava absolutely answers.

Deadeye: Deadeye: Lioneye needed walls; you only need a horizon.
Deadeye: Hyrri’s last shot became legend; yours never live long enough to be told.
Deadeye: Solaris lights the target, Lunaris bends the path, and you never miss either.
Pathfinder: Pathfinder: Tasalio guides the current; your flasks guide the slaughter.
Pathfinder: Maraketh scouts read tracks; you read the colour of every puddle you leave behind.
Pathfinder: Hinekora sees the path ahead; your toxins decorate it.

Amazon: Amazon: Maraketh riders fear few things; a spear in each hand is one of them.
Amazon: Rakiata taught Karui spears to dance; you taught them to hunt gods.
Amazon: From Ngamakanui shores to Oriath’s ruins, every thrown spear signs your name.
Ritualist: Ritualist: Hinekora counts the dead; you arrange them in pleasing circles.
Ritualist: Azmeri shamans whisper to spirits; you negotiate in blood and ash.
Ritualist: When the moon rises over Wraeclast, your altars wake up hungry.

Blood Mage: Blood Mage: Doryani measured power in screams; you prefer more precise litres.
Blood Mage: Atziri traded life for worship; you trade it wholesale for damage.
Blood Mage: Every cast redraws the line between ‘vital resource’ and ‘excess inventory.’
Lich: Lich: Malachai wrote his notes in lives; you write yours in what remains afterward.
Lich: Oriath fears undeath; Wraeclast just calls it job security.
Lich: When Innocence fell, something kept moving. You took notes.
Infernalist: Infernalist: Ngamahu loves a good blaze; you love a world that doesn’t stop burning.
Infernalist: Atziri played with fire; you rewrote the rules for ‘acceptable sacrifice.’
Infernalist: Solaris shines, Lunaris wanes, and your hellfire ignores both schedules.
Abyssal Lich: Abyssal Lich: Vaal ruins have a bottom; the pit you’re staring into does not.
Abyssal Lich: Chayula dreams in violet; you dream in whatever’s left after the void is done.
Abyssal Lich: Hinekora knows how you die; the abyss just wants to replay it.

Stormweaver: Stormweaver: Solaris provides the light, Lunaris provides the rhythm, and you conduct the screaming.
Stormweaver: Lioneye’s Legion feared siege engines; they never met your weather.
Stormweaver: Valako thunders approval every time you overkill something.
Chronomancer: Chronomancer: Atziri rewrote history; you rewrite the part where you should have died.
Chronomancer: Dominus thought time was on his side; you turned it into a consumable.
Chronomancer: When Hinekora shows the future, you pause, edit, and rewind.

Invoker: Invoker: Esh crackles in your knuckles, Xoph smolders in your stance, Tul waits patiently in your breath.
Invoker: Azmeri monasteries taught restraint; Wraeclast taught better applications.
Invoker: Every strike is a sermon; every elemental echo is the amen.
Acolyte of Chayula: Acolyte of Chayula: Chayula’s lullaby is a scream only you find soothing.
Acolyte of Chayula: Reality frays at the edges; you pull on the loose threads.
Acolyte of Chayula: When others wake from nightmares, you mark them as training.

Witch Hunter: Witch Hunter: Theopolis writes edicts; you write full stops at the end of sorcerers.
Witch Hunter: Victario roused the people; you quiet the heretics.
Witch Hunter: Dominus loved loyal hounds; you prefer rabid ones with crossbows.
Gemling Legionnaire: Gemling Legionnaire: Oriath’s gems broke armies; you break whatever survives the shattering.
Gemling Legionnaire: Theopolis bred you for obedience; Wraeclast retrained you for efficiency.
Gemling Legionnaire: Every socket in your gear is a reminder of how much they underestimated you.
Tactician: Tactician: Victario planned revolutions; you plan ambushes that actually work.
Tactician: Lioneye trusted walls; you trust lines of fire and a good choke point.
Tactician: When the battle looks even, it’s because your traps are perfectly placed.
